title: Billy Berg's new place, the Orson Welles show and Teddy Bunn
summary: Dance reads the biography for spring 1945, when Zutty played Berg's new club on Vine Street; they talk about Teddy Bunn, last heard with Louis Jordan's band.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well now, after T-Bone, it says you do Orson Welles radio show, worked with Teddy Bunn
and then Slim Galliard in the Spring of '45.
Yes, that was at Billy Berg's new place. They had moved on Vine Street about this time.
Did you, do you ever hear anything of Teddy Bunn?
The last time we heard he was here you know with Louis Jordan's band.
Oh, that was how long ago?
Oh Lord. That must have been about, I guess about ten years ago.
He lived in Riverside didn't he?
